report.clinical_summary: The patient has been diagnosed with HIV 5 months ago and is on Dovato (dolutegravir + lamivudine), one tablet daily. They report good progress in lab results (viral load and CD4 trending in the right direction) but are experiencing headaches that are less frequent but still bothersome. They describe the illness as having a major impact on their life - affecting work, time with children, and causing constant anxiety and uncertainty. They feel they have limited control over their health and worry about long-term complications like AIDS-related dementia. They believe the causes were a combination of factors including hormonal imbalances, work and relationship stress, and personal choices that put them at risk. They view the medication as crucial but feel they have less control over it than they'd like.
